mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MP_REVIEW WHERE RESTAURANT_ID = #{restaurantId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL

SELECT r.ID, r.RESTAURANT_ID, r.USER_ID, r.RATING, r.SOLO_SCORE, r.REVIEW_COMMENT, r.STATUS, TO_CHAR(r.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(r.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as UPDATED_AT, r.DELETED_AT, r.MENU_SCORE, r.SEAT_SCORE, u.USERNAME as USERNAME FROM mp_review r INNER JOIN mp_user u ON r.USER_ID = u.ID WHERE r.RESTAURANT_ID = #{restaurantId} AND r.DELETED_AT IS NULL
ORDER BY LENGTHB(r.REVIEW_COMMENT) DESC
ORDER BY r.RATING DESC
ORDER BY r.RATING ASC
ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mp_review ( id, restaurant_id, user_id, rating, solo_score, menu_score, seat_score, review_comment, status, created_at ) VALUES ( mp_reviews_seq.NEXTVAL, #{restaurantId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{menuScore} + #{seatScore}, #{menuScore}, #{seatScore}, #{reviewComment}, 'ACTIVE', SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE mp_review SET rating = #{rating}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, menu_score = #{menuScore}, seat_score = #{seatScore}, solo_score = #{soloScore}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE mp_review SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE MP_RESTAURANT r SET r.RATING_COUNT = ( SELECT COUNT(rw.ID) FROM MP_REVIEW rw WHERE rw.RESTAURANT_ID = r.ID AND rw.DELETED_AT IS NULL ), r.AVG_RATING = ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(rw.RATING),1) FROM MP_REVIEW rw WHERE rw.RESTAURANT_ID = r.ID AND rw.DELETED_AT IS NULL ), r.SOLO_INDEX = ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(rw.SOLO_SCORE),1) FROM MP_REVIEW rw WHERE rw.RESTAURANT_ID = r.ID AND rw.DELETED_AT IS NULL ), r.AVG_MENU_SCORE = ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(rw.MENU_SCORE),1) FROM MP_REVIEW rw WHERE rw.RESTAURANT_ID = r.ID AND rw.DELETED_AT IS NULL ), r.AVG_SEAT_SCORE = ( SELECT ROUND(AVG(rw.SEAT_SCORE),1) FROM MP_REVIEW rw WHERE rw.RESTAURANT_ID = r.ID AND rw.DELETED_AT IS NULL ), r.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE r.id = #{restaurantId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.ID AS review_id, r.REVIEW_COMMENT AS review_comment, r.RATING AS rating, TO_CHAR(r.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as CREATED_AT, r.MENU_SCORE AS menu_score, r.SEAT_SCORE AS seat_score, re.ID AS restaurant_id, re.NAME AS restaurant_name, re.PHOTO_URL AS restaurant_photo_url, re.AVG_RATING AS restaurant_avg_rating FROM mp_review r INNER JOIN mp_restaurant re ON r.RESTAURANT_ID = re.ID WHERE r.USER_ID = #{userId} AND r.DELETED_AT IS NULL
